assignedTasks.title: Topic Card Component (Global/Trending)
assignedTasks.description:
Create the base Topic Card component according to the Explore and Main screen wireframes. Requirements: 
1. Title font 600 weight.
2. Category pill mapping (e.g., Tech = Blue, Business = Purple).
3. Live countdown timer badge (e.g., '26h left').
4. Participant count ('1.2K' format).
5. Hover state: slight opacity change or border highlight.
6. Click handler placeholder for navigation.

assignedTasks.title: Explore Screen: Category Horizontal Scroller
assignedTasks.description:
Build the horizontal scrollable category pill selector for the Explore screen. Requirements:
1. Pills must snap to scroll.
2. Active state (e.g., Purple background for selected 'All' pill).
3. Inactive state (Dark surface background).
4. Hide native scrollbars (use ::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }).
5. Implement mock state for switching active category.

assignedTasks.title: Topic Room Detail Header (Global Room)
assignedTasks.description:
Implement the persistent Top App Bar for the Global Chat room. Requirements:
1. Back arrow icon.
2. Topic Title (centered, bold).
3. 'More' (ellipsis) icon button.
4. Fixed position at the top during scroll.
5. Filter bar row just below the header (All, Host only, You).

assignedTasks.title: Share Topic Modal Sheet
assignedTasks.description:
Build the bottom-sheet modal for sharing a topic. Requirements:
1. Topic Summary block.
2. 'Copy Link' input field with copy button.
3. QR Code placeholder box (dashed border).
4. 'Open native share' primary green button.
5. Slide-up animation on enter, slide-down on exit.
